summary: Generic Canadian federal immigration policy expert (IRCC Express Entry / CRS / CEC / FSW / FST). Fetches policy in real time from official sources, detects and surfaces updates, and computes multi-stream eligibility plus CRS scoring (with itemized detail) for any candidate. All policy judgements follow live official sources, never stale offline data.
